Greater Akron Chamber · Card Scanner · version 0.4.8

Scan, check, approve, export. Admin jobs are in the Admin Guide. Pictures use made-up cards.

1. Sign in

Open GAC Card Scanner. Use your own username and password.

  • The top of every page says You are: your name. Not you? Click Not you?. It signs you out.
  • After 30 minutes with no clicks you are signed out (not while photos upload). The sign-in page then says so.
  • Locked out? Ask an admin.

2. Scan

  1. Click Scan cards.
  2. Type a batch name (e.g. After Hours). The date and your initials are added.
  3. Drop the photos on the box, or click Scan.

One card per photo, flat, no glare. You can review while the rest are read.

On the Scan page: Needs a look = check the photo · Blocked = fix before approving · Not added = skipped · Cancelled = stopped.

3. Review one card

Click Review batch →. Check each field against the photo.

Do this How
See where a field was read Tap the field. Esc = whole photo.
Fix a field Type, then Save.
Approve Approve, or Enter (not while typing in a field).
Reject Reject, or R. It asks first.
Next / previous card Skip, J / K, or the arrow keys.
Undo Undo on the message after Approve, Ctrl+Z, or U. It undoes your last change in the current batch only, for up to 2 hours. The button shows what it will undo and the batch.
  • Yellow = check the photo.
  • changed = the scanner tidied it. Hover to see what it read.
  • Blocked = fix before approving.
  • Red box: fix the field. If the card really shows it like that, an admin must confirm it: a misread in name, title, company or department, or a block on email, website or address. Click Needs admin to flag the card.

4. Same person?

If a card looks like another one, you see both side by side.

  • Same: one card is kept. New details are added to it.
  • Different: both are kept.

Answer this first. Enter won't approve until you do. A card in someone else's batch shows only as a count ("Looks like 1 card in another batch"): click Different if it's not the same person, or ask an admin. If the same person was exported before, or may be in MC Trade, Approve asks once more and names the earlier export.

If you edit a card that was already exported, the message says the edit won't be exported again unless an admin includes it.

5. Export

  1. Click Export. Your current batch is chosen.
  2. Click Preview to check the rows.
  3. Click Export, then Save.
  • To check = cards to look at before the import. The READ-ME lists them.
  • Import only the file named IMPORT-ME_…xlsx. Files named NOT-FOR-IMPORT_… are for reading.
  • You can export only your own batch. Other batches: ask an admin.
  • Export marks the cards as exported. Preview doesn't.
  • Export blocked: open the listed cards and fix them, or click Needs admin.
  • The READ-ME starts with one line, for example Ready to import: 3 rows (2 clean, 1 to check). Not in the file: 1 edited after export. Test 2 rows first.
  • Nothing new to import: no file is made. The page says why (for example, the card was edited after export).
  • Edited after export: a card you change after it was exported is not in the next file. Only an admin can put it in again.
  • N waiting for admin: cards you sent with Needs admin. They are not in the file until an admin checks them.

6. Ask an admin

Your admin: ask the front desk.

Ask an admin when:

  • you are locked out;
  • a red box says An admin needs to confirm this.
  • you need to export someone else's batch.
